# EntreSkill Hub

> A Next.js 16 (App Router) web application designed for micro-entrepreneurs. It provides structured roadmaps, learning resources, and mentor connections to help turn skills into businesses.

## System Guidelines
When contributing to or analyzing this project, adhere to the following architecture and performance guidelines.

### Technologies
- Framework: Next.js 16 (React 19)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- Architecture: React Server Components (RSC) preferred.
- Icons: Lucide React

### Performance & UI Standards
- CSS-only animations for main layout components.
- Image optimization enabled with `next/image`.
- Sentry loaded dynamically to prevent main thread blocking.
- Strict adherence to WCAG AA accessibility standards.
